remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946." Backing inscription dates 1937. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1936. Dated 1936 on basis of inclusion in 1937 New York (An American Place – O'Keeffe) exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Mule's Skull with Pink Poinsettia

description: Vertical canvas of pink hills with large frontal view of a mule's skull in the lower left.  Large cloud-filled blue sky with two floating pink poinsettia flowers, both almost as large as the skull, hovering above in the sky in the middle and upper right of the canvas.
